name: Omnath, Locus of the Void
oracle_text:
Omnath gets +1/+1 for each unspent mana you have.
If you would lose unspent mana, that mana becomes colorless instead.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, add {C}{C}.
blocked_sentences: Omnath gets +1/+1 for each unspent mana you have.
If you would lose unspent mana, that mana becomes colorless instead.

needs.what: a player-wide static (Kruphix, Omnath, Locus of the Void) that, when the controller's mana pool would empty between steps and phases, keeps every unspent mana but converts each one to {C}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `mana_retention` keeps the mana in its original colors (Leyline Tyrant / Upwelling), and the packet notes say outright that 'that mana becomes colorless instead' is not it and is still a gap

needs.what: a value (usable as a static `buff` amount) reading the total amount of unspent mana in the controller's mana pool, so 'gets +1/+1 for each unspent mana you have' tracks the pool continuously
needs.why_existing_wont_do: neither `value_keys` nor `static_value_keys` has anything that reads the mana pool; `mana_spent_of` and `colors_of_mana_spent` read mana spent on a spell, not mana still floating
